description_en: Queries the alerting status for unapproved logon IP addresses, unapproved logon time ranges, or unapproved logon accounts
description_zh: 查询非常用登录IP、非常用登录时间、非常用登录账号的报警开关信息
name: DescribeLoginSwitchConfigs

Item.description_en:
The type of the alert that you enabled or disabled. Valid values:

login_common_ip: alerts for unapproved logon IP addresses
login_common_time: alerts for unapproved logon time ranges
login_common_account: alerts for unapproved logon accounts
Item.description_zh:
指定要开启或关闭的开关类型。
取值：
login_common_ip：  非常用登录IP告警
login_common_time： 非常用登录时间告警
login_common_account： 非常用账号登录告警

Status.description_en:
The status of the Log Service feature. Valid values:

0: The feature is disabled.
1: The feature is enabled
Status.description_zh:
日志服务的启用状态。
取值：
0：关闭
1：开启

Count.description_en: The number of returned configuration items
Count.description_zh: 配置列表的返回个数信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
